comparison.scope: Derived diagnostics from trusted committed adapter snapshots; not a standalone save authenticator. Mechanism projection equality is not observer knowledge equality. Constitution, plastic adaptation, effective disposition, identity standing and execution remain distinct. No general personality, qualified character narration or independent causal necessity claim.
comparison.alignment: Equal committed native prefixes only. Unequal prefixes withhold equality and field comparison.
comparison.randomPolicy: Original run seed is fixed; input calendars retain their routed instant seeds. Equal seeds do not establish equal addressed draws or action causes.
comparison.fieldEquality: Exact readable-text equality and presence, matching the original comparison. Values stay in revision-bound pages; this is not canonical-byte equality or semantic/causal significance.

report.scope: Stored constitution and plastic contribution at this committed revision. Refold has no stored plastic leaf; absence is not zero. These two scalars are not a general personality vector, identity standing, effective disposition or character self-knowledge. The owning worker must bind this projection to the save revision; it does not authenticate state on its own.
